sources.title: Using Adapters at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Load a base transformers model with the AutoAdapterModel class provided by Adapters. Use the load_adapter () method to load and add an adapter. Activate the adapter via active_adapters (for inference) or activate and set it as trainable via train_adapter () (for training). Make sure to also check out composition of adapters.

sources.snippet: Note: Adapters has replaced the adapter-transformers library and is fully compatible in terms of model weights. See here for more. Adapters is an add-on library to 🤗 transformers for efficiently fine-tuning pre-trained language models using adapters and other parameter-efficient methods.
